batches.outcome: Discovered circuit/netlist and optimization pools; continued toward exact public artifacts rather than headline scores.

NMR yielded individual responses. Process-mining lacked task ground truth; additive-manufacturing results did not yield an inspected task-level failure. Lean search yielded no usable exact new candidate.
Opened linguistic task/response archives, causal query references and SPICE grading artifacts.
The two narrowly targeted HN queries yielded no usable anecdote. Causal search reached the primary dataset. FrontierCS follow-up exposed a specific oracle defect and infrastructure exclusions.

Reddit circuit discussion raised schematic-image versus netlist representation and supplied counter-anecdotes of success. HN counterexample discussions did not yield a new bounded completed-failure fixture. No anecdotes were counted as model-failure receipts.

No usable DisproofBench or exact Terra counterexample artifact found. Music search yielded WildScore and ONOTE primary repositories, but no inspected exact Terra failure. Geospatial results were discovery leads only and were not promoted from secondary summaries.

direct_followups: Inspected six new GitHub recursive trees; pinned exact raw files. Refreshed the existing Terminal-Bench-Science matrix and read eight previously unbanked instructions.
Audited nine external Terra result/lock/verifier triplets for three new science tasks; counted seven normal completed misses and excluded two AgentTimeoutError runs.
Opened published Terra/max answers and scoring metadata from Razavi-Bench; visually inspected the exact Figure 16 and read matching curated netlists.
Replayed narrow positional-binding, linguistic normalization and receipt-completion checks without models or package installation.
Inspected exact causal query rows 164 and 169 and their identification/estimation references; no matching individual failure outputs were recovered.
stop_rules: Do not promote an aggregate, parser failure, timeout, model-judge score or unknown-source variant as a verified Terra failure.
Reject compound work and repetition added to manufacture difficulty, even when the verifier is fast.
Do not fill the 100-task target with sibling variants, ambiguous references or unmeasured extractions.
